text:
Woke up to "Hakone Ropeway: service suspended"? Don't cancel the day. From Gora, two short bus rides put you on Lake Ashi in about 20 minutes for ¥910, and the Freepass covers it 👇

🤔 Guess which is quicker from Gora to Togendai: the bus or the cable car plus ropeway? The answer surprised us 👉 https://japanbystation.com/hakone-ropeway-closed-plan-b

We checked the live status page, the bus timetables and the refund rules against Odakyu's own pages. On the morning we looked, the ropeway and the lake cruise were both stopped by wind, while trains and buses ran normally. That mix is common.

🚌 A · KEEP THE LAKE

Bus from Gora to Kowakien (4 minutes), then the H line to Moto-Hakone (14 minutes). You're at the lake and Hakone Shrine's torii before your coffee goes cold.

🎨 B · STAY AROUND GORA

If the boats are stopped too, slow down. The Hakone Open-Air Museum is open every day from 9:00 to 17:00, with indoor galleries for the rainy hours, and tofu katsuni was born two minutes from Gora Station.

📅 C · MOVE THE DAY

Only if the gondola view over Owakudani was the whole reason you came. An online Romancecar ticket can move to another date once, and a refund before departure is ¥100 a seat.

💭 OUR TAKE

Ropeway down but buses running? Go anyway. You'll still get the lake, the shrine and a hot bath.

👉 The refund most Freepass holders forget to ask for, plus the full ropeway-free route:
https://japanbystation.com/hakone-ropeway-closed-plan-b

What would you choose on a windy day: lake by bus, or museum and onsen?
